input.rationale: Section 4(c) sets out the only effects of termination: Kubient ceases the Services, the licence is revoked, Customer stops using the platform, and each Party returns or destroys the other's Confidential Information. There is no transition or wind-down assistance and no obligation to return or export Customer's Content, Requests or other data in a usable format, nor any certified-deletion timing — a search for transition/exit/export/migration language returns nothing elsewhere in the Agreement. For a hosted auction-platform service this omission fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus export within 30 days), and the bare "return or destroy" of Confidential Information leaves Kubient free to destroy our data on termination, which is walk-away territory. Redline inserts the preferred position (up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable return within 30 days, certified deletion thereafter) as new sub-clauses (v)-(vii) of section 4(c); the 90-day fallback is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return/deletion obligations into section 4(c) (effects of termination)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit: up to six months of transition assistance at Kubient's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. Section 4(c) currently only stops the Services, leaving no route to recover our data or migrate; we can accept a 90-day assistance period if six months is not workable.

ops.text: (v) at Customer's request, Kubient shall provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Kubient's then-current rates; (vi) within thirty (30) days of termination or expiration, Kubient shall return to Customer, in a commonly used, machine-readable format, all Content, Requests and other data of or relating to Customer then in Kubient's possession or control; and (vii) thereafter Kubient shall delete such Content, Requests and data from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.
